entries.def: a Roman mile, milliarium , = 1000 paces,= 8 stades, = 1680 yards, i. e. 80 yards less than our mile, (Polybius Historicus), etc. (ML)

μιμέομαι, -οῦμαι
(μῖμος, a mimic, an actor), [in LXX: Psa.31.6, Wis.4.2; 15.9, 4Ma.9.23 4Mac.9.13 : * ;] 
to imitate: 2Th.3.7; 3.9 Heb.13.7, 3Jn.11.†
(AS)

μιμητής, -οῦ, ὁ
(μιμέομαι), 
in NT always (like the verb) in good sense, an imitator: 1Co.4.16; 11.1, Eph.5.1, 1Th.1.6; 2.14, Heb.6.12.†
(AS)

μιμνήσκω
(Bl., -ῄ-, § 3, 3), [in LXX chiefly for זָכַר ;] 
to remind: mid, and pass.; 
__(a) reflexive, to remind oneself of, hence, to remember: with genitive of thing(s), Mat.26.75, Luk.1.54, 72; 24.8, Act.11.16, 2Pe.3.2, Jude.17; with neg., of sins, = to forgive, Heb.8.12; 10.17" (LXX) ; with genitive of person(s), Luk.23.42 before ὅτι, Mat.5.23; 27.63, Luk.16.25, Jhn.2.17, 22; 12.16; ὡς, Luk.24.6 pf., μέμνημι,…

μισέω, -ῶ 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂנֵא ;] 
to hate: with accusative of person(s) Mat.5.43; 24.10, Luk.1.71; 6.22, 27; 19.14, Jhn.7.7; 15.18-19, 23-26; 17.14, Tit.3.3, 1Jn.2.9 Jhn.2.11 Jhn.3.13 Jhn.3.15 Jhn.4.20 Rev.17.16; pass., Mat.10.22; 24.9, Mrk.13.13, Luk.21.17; with accusative of thing(s), Jhn.3.20, Rom.7.15, Eph.5.29, Heb.1.9, Jude.23, Rev.2.6; pass., Rev.18.2. As the Heb. שָׂנֵא is sometimes found with the…

μισθαποδοσία, -ας, ἡ
(μισθός, ἀποδίδωμι; cl. μισθοδοσία), 
pay­ment of wages, recompense; meton., 
__(a) of reward: Heb.10.35; 11.26; 
__(b) of punishment : Heb.2.2.†
(AS)

μισθ-απο-δότης, -ου, ὁ 
(see supr.), 
one who pays wages; meton., a rewarder: Heb.11.6.†
(AS)

μίσθιος, -α, -ον
(also -ος, -ον), [in LXX: Lev.19.13 A Lev.25.50, Job.7.1 (שָׂכִיר), Tob.5.11, Sir.7.10; 31.22; 37.11 * ;] 
hired; as subst., ὁ μ., a hired servant: Luk.15.17, 19; 15.21 (Anth., Plut.).†
(AS)

μισθός, -οῦ, ὁ 
[in LXX chiefly for שָׂכָר ;] 
__1. prop., wages, hire: Mat.20.8, Luk.10.7, Rom.4.4, 1Ti.5.18, Jas.5.4, Jude.11; μ. ἀδικίας, Act.1.18, 2Pe.2.13 (but see Mayor and ICC, in l), 2Pe.2.15. 
__2. Generally, reward: Jhn.4.36, 1Co.9.18; esp. of divine rewards, Mat.5.12; 6.1-2, 5; 6.16; 10.41-42 Mrk.9.41, Luk.6.23, 35, 1Co.3.8; 3.14, 2Jn.8, Rev.11.18; 22.12; ἔχειν μ., Mat.5.46, 1Co.9.17.†
(AS)

μισθόω, -ῶ
(μισθός) [in LXX (mid.) chiefly for שָׂכָר ;] 
to let out for hire. Mid., to hire: with accusative, Mat.20.1, 7.†
(AS)
